nodes.title: How to use this template
widgets_values:
## WaveSpeed AI — Universal Generation node

This template uses the **WaveSpeedAI Predictor** node, a single node that can call any of the 600+ models hosted on WaveSpeed AI (image, video, audio, 3D, ...).

### Setup
1. Install the custom node: **Manager → Custom Nodes Manager → "WaveSpeed AI - Universal Generation"** (registry id `wavespeed-comfyui`).
2. Get an API key at [wavespeed.ai](https://wavespeed.ai) (free tier available).
3. In ComfyUI: **Settings → WaveSpeed → API Key**, paste the key, then reload the page.

> The first load after adding a key fetches the model catalog once (5-10s). After that, model and parameter lists are instant.

### Using this workflow
Pick a different model straight from the node - the parameter fields rebuild themselves for that model, so the rest of the graph keeps working.

[Node repository](https://github.com/WaveSpeedAI/wavespeed-comfyui) · [Docs](https://wavespeed.ai/docs)
